The Master's ETA is consistent: check_eta computes 2025-01-31T12:18:00Z from the 1,503.8 nm to Sept-Iles at 12.5 kn, within 2 h of the Master's 11:00 UTC ETA, so no ETA confirmation from the Master is needed and no ETA notice is due now (last notice went to the agent on 2025-01-25 for a 5-day arrival; the ETA moved only 5 h, inside the 12 h change limit, and days-to-ETA is 4.96).

The stop agrees with the report: check_stoppage confirms the main engine stop 2025-01-26T06:10–11:40 UTC (5.5 h, VLSFO 1.1 t) lies within the report day and the 18.5 h steaming speed reproduces the 231.3 nm run. Since the remarks explain the stop, nothing is queried with the Master.

Judgement under the CP off-hire clause: loss of time from breakdown/defect of machinery or equipment is off hire, so the choked fuel-oil filters stopping the main engine puts the ship off hire for the full stop; a stop on charterers' orders would not be. However, because the sludge may lie in charterer-supplied fuel, the owner may argue that point — the claim is the operator's to make.

The simulated off-hire statement (figures made up for this demo, from the stand-in system) shows: hire deducted $2,177.08 (5.5 h at $9,500/day), bunkers $660 (1.1 t VLSFO at $600/t) to the owners' account, total $2,837.08.

Because my judgement is off hire: the operator should decide whether to put MV TORMAR SPRING off hire for 2025-01-26T06:10–11:40 UTC and notify the owner (Tormar Bulk Carriers). On a yes: (a) propose an off-hire entry in the voyage management system for that period, and (b) e-mail the owner's vessel technical management with the period and reason, asking for the engine log extract for the stop.

draft.body:
Dear Owner,

MV TORMAR SPRING is put off hire for a main-engine stop from 2025-01-26T06:10 to 11:40 UTC (5.5 h).

Reason: fuel oil filters choked with sludge stirred up in heavy weather. The filters were cleaned, the engine was restarted, and the vessel resumed passage.

VLSFO used during stoppage: 1.1 t (generators and boiler), for owners' account per CP.

Hire deducted: $2,177.08 (5.5 h at $9,500/day).
Bunkers: $660 (1.1 t VLSFO at $600/t).
Total: $2,837.08.

Please provide the engine log extract for the stop.

Best regards,
Operations
